description: Two modes for the same workflow compiler. (1) Free deterministic rendering: pass `{ spec }` with a prepared VisualSpec v0.1. Unseen validates the contract and citations, heals connectors, and renders it without calling server AI or using credits. (2) Hosted AI generation: omit `spec` and pass `{ text }` or `{ sources }` with verbatim excerpts. Unseen's server-side AI drafts the spec using a free generation slot or prepaid credits. Both modes require sign-in and return citations, SVG, Mermaid, Excalidraw, and an owner-only Studio link when saved. See the `compile-sop-host-llm` and `generate-sop-hosted-ai` prompts for examples. For structural edits, update the spec and render again or call `autofix_workflow`.

authToken.description: Optional session token (`utok_...`) obtained from `auth_verify_otp` or `auth_login` if not already supplied in the HTTP `Authorization: Bearer` header.

granularity.description: Target scope level: 'overview' for a parent lifecycle summary, 'subprocess' when paired with focusSourceIds, or 'all'.

swimlane.description: Optional swimlane layout toggle (defaults to automatic swimlanes when 2+ actor groups exist)

evidenceCoverage.description: Optional document preflight coverage report from the host agent (`pagesExamined`, `totalPages`, `textExtracted`, `tablesExtracted`, `embeddedDiagramsDetected`, `omittedMedia`, `notes`). When omitted media or uninspected diagrams are reported, Unseen flags `EVIDENCE_NOT_INSPECTED`.

focusSourceIds.description: Optional subset of source IDs to focus on when compiling a specific subprocess or phase returned by detect_workflows.

hostContext.description: Optional advisory context observed by the host agent

includeExcalidraw.description: Explicitly include or omit inline Excalidraw scene JSON (defaults to true only for 'full').

includeSvg.description: Explicitly include or omit inline SVG XML (defaults to true for 'full' and 'svg', false for 'preview'/'compact'/'mermaid').

jobId.description: Exact jobId returned by needs_input. Resend the original evidence and all answers before expiresAt.

maxPreviewHeight.description: Target preview height bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 900).

maxPreviewWidth.description: Target preview width bound in px for responsive preview metadata (default 1200).

priorAnswers.description: Answers to prior Unseen clarification questions when resuming a compilation

answer.description: User's answer to the clarification question

renderFormat.description: Optional output size control (defaults to 'full'). Use 'preview' for a bounded inline PNG on the hosted service, with Mermaid and an owner-only SVG URL when available, or 'svg'/'mermaid' for a single format.

sources.description: Hosted AI mode when `spec` is omitted. Pass 1–60 verbatim excerpts with locators, up to 2,000 characters each. Preserve thresholds, actors, and branches. Uses the account's generation allowance or credits.

spec.description: Free deterministic mode. Pass a prepared VisualSpec v0.1 (`{schemaVersion:'0.1', kind:'flowchart', title, summary, sources, nodes, edges}`). Label outgoing decision edges. Unseen validates and renders it at zero credits without server AI.

text.description: Hosted AI mode when `spec` is omitted. Pass raw text if `sources` is omitted or empty. Unseen segments it and uses the account's generation allowance or credits.

userGoal.description: The overarching operational goal or process description (defaults to `spec.title` or the first line of `text`/`sources` if omitted)

name: compile_workflow
title: Render or Generate Workflow Diagram
